result.title: SearchHorizonBench: A Benchmark for Search Value in AI Agents
result.summary: AI agents must decide when another search is worth its cost. Answer-success probabilities capture question difficulty, while this decision requires estimating the additional benefit of search. We introduce SearchHorizonBench, a benchmark for learning and evaluating search value from execution experience. Paired continuations and repeated executions separate expected search gain from generation noise and connect prediction quality to decision utility. The resource contains 45,632 executions across 3,168 questions. On 1,632 held-out questions, historical calibration reduces Brier error by 16.2%, with the improvement concentrated in success-level information. Search gains have a standard deviation of 21.4 percentage points, and tested historical estimators explain less than 2% of this variance in point estimates. Matched-configuration learning curves probe this distinction across training scales. At the reference token price, free selection observations yield a 2.49-point utility opportunity over the best constant action, driven primarily by gain information. Reusable histories, frozen splits, strong baselines and scoring tools provide a common foundation for developing and evaluating value-aware search agents.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作构建 SearchHorizonBench，用 3,168 个问题、45,632 次执行及配对续写来区分「再进行一次搜索的期望收益」与生成噪声，并考察收益预测质量如何转化为决策效用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「额外一步计算的边际收益」与停止决策效用显式分离并量化的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止判据与成本收益评估；能否迁移到多模态视觉证据获取尚需阅读原文。
